from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document found in the collection, with its title and legal cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The formal title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action or case type identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_documents: list[CaseDocument]
